Walkman UI Map

79 screens of Sony's stock player UI, captured 2026-09-23 on an NW-A55 running Walkman One 3.02. Each card shows the screen, how to reach it and what it opens. Screens are 480×800 and driven by touch; the hardware keys are transport and power only. Bottom bar on almost every screen: Back · Now Playing · Library · Option menu.

Now Playing (11)Sound panel (9)Library (30)Settings (28)System (1)

Now Playing

The start screen. Four more screens hang off it by swipes only.

Now Playing

Swipe left: Bookmark List. Swipe right: Play Queue. Swipe up: sound panel. Swipe down: Library. Nothing on screen shows these; the help overlay does.

  • From All Songs: tap a song (it starts playing)
  • Opens Bookmark List: swipe left
  • Opens Play Queue: swipe right
  • Opens Library: swipe down, or tap the Library button
  • Opens Option menu — Now Playing: tap Option (toolbox)
  • Opens Volume (overlay): tap the status bar (any screen)
  • Opens Sound panel — Dynamic Normalizer: swipe up (page 4 of 5)
  • Opens Sound panel — Equalizer: swipe up (page 1; the panel reopens on the last page used, and pages wrap)

Bookmark List

  • From Now Playing: swipe left
  • Opens Option menu — Bookmark List: tap Option (toolbox)

Option menu — Bookmark List

  • From Bookmark List: tap Option (toolbox)
  • Opens Settings: tap Settings

  • Opens Context menu — a Play Queue song: tap a row's ⋯ button

  • Opens Detailed Song Information: tap Detailed Song Information
  • Opens Select List to Add to (playlists): tap Add to Playlist

  • From Context menu — a song row: tap Detailed Song Information
  • From Option menu — Now Playing: tap Detailed Song Information

  • Opens Change Playback Screen (choice): tap Change Playback Screen
  • Opens Lyrics (overlay): tap Display Lyrics
  • Opens Now Playing help overlay (the swipe map): tap View Help
  • Opens Settings: tap Settings
  • Opens Detailed Song Information: tap Detailed Song Information
  • Opens Select List to Add to (playlists): tap Add to Playlist (Add to Bookmark List opens the same kind of picker)

Sound panel

Swipe up on Now Playing: five effect pages side by side, with the Direct switch in the title strip.

Sound panel — Dynamic Normalizer

  • From Now Playing: swipe up (page 4 of 5)
  • From Sound panel — DC Phase Linearizer: swipe left
  • Opens Sound panel — Vinyl Processor: swipe left (page 5)

Sound panel — Vinyl Processor

  • From Sound panel — Dynamic Normalizer: swipe left (page 5)
  • Opens Sound panel — Equalizer: swipe left (wraps)

Sound panel — Equalizer

  • From Now Playing: swipe up (page 1; the panel reopens on the last page used, and pages wrap)
  • From Sound panel — Vinyl Processor: swipe left (wraps)
  • From Sound panel — Tone Control (replaces the Equalizer page): Option menu: tap Equalizer (switches back)
  • Opens Sound panel — DSEE HX: swipe left (page 2)
  • Opens Sound panel — Tone Control (replaces the Equalizer page): Option menu: tap Tone Control
  • Opens Equalizer — Adjust: tap Adjust

Sound panel — DSEE HX

  • From Sound panel — Equalizer: swipe left (page 2)
  • Opens Sound panel — DC Phase Linearizer: swipe left (page 3)

Sound panel — DC Phase Linearizer

  • From Sound panel — DSEE HX: swipe left (page 3)
  • Opens Sound panel — Dynamic Normalizer: swipe left
  • Opens Select Type (choice dialog): tap the Select Type box (same on DSEE HX and Vinyl Processor)
  • Opens Saved Sound Settings: Option menu: tap Saved Sound Settings (also a Settings row)

Select Type (choice dialog)

  • From Sound panel — DC Phase Linearizer: tap the Select Type box (same on DSEE HX and Vinyl Processor)

Saved Sound Settings

  • From Settings: tap Saved Sound Settings

Sound panel — Tone Control (replaces the Equalizer page)

  • Opens Sound panel — Equalizer: Option menu: tap Equalizer (switches back)

Equalizer — Adjust

  • From Sound panel — Equalizer: tap Adjust

Library

Swipe down on Now Playing, or the Library button in the bottom bar.

Library

Two pages of category tiles (swipe left/right). Tap and hold a tile to reorder. The DAC and phone buttons ask to turn on USB DAC / Bluetooth Receiver.

  • From Now Playing: swipe down, or tap the Library button
  • Opens Recent Transfers: page 2: tap Recent Transfers
  • Opens Folder: page 2: tap Folder
  • Opens SensMe™ Channels — songs not analysed notice: page 2: tap SensMe™ Channels (starts a channel playing)
  • Opens All Songs: tap All Songs
  • Opens Album: tap Album
  • Opens Artist: tap Artist
  • Opens Genre: tap Genre
  • Opens Release Year: tap Release Year
  • Opens Composer: tap Composer
  • Opens Playlists: tap Playlists
  • Opens Hi-Res: tap Hi-Res
  • Opens Turn on USB DAC? (dialog): tap the DAC button
  • Opens Turn on Bluetooth Receiver? (dialog): tap the phone-and-waves button
  • Opens Option menu — Library: tap Option (toolbox)
